products.name: Connected Papers
products.note: Visual paper graph; literature discovery; academic research; Israeli vendor

profile_text.body:
Connected Papers is an Israeli company that offers a visual tool designed to help researchers and applied scientists discover and explore academic papers relevant to their fields. The product generates a visual graph of connected literature, allowing users to navigate relationships between papers rather than relying solely on traditional keyword search.

The company's single tracked product shares its name and sits in the search, research, and literature discovery category. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts.
